ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, the straight line $DE$ intersects with $BC$ at point $O$, $\angle COE$ and $\angle AOE$ are complementary, and $\angle BOD=35^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle AOE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $\angle COE = \angle BOD$,\\
$\angle BOD = 35^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle COE = 35^\circ$,\\
since $\angle COE$ and $\angle AOE$ are complementary,\\
thus $\angle COE + \angle AOE = 90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle AOE = 90^\circ - \angle COE = \boxed{55^\circ}$.
